title: Contract Form, Network Access Conditions and Service Area of the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans
content:
Each Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan is written on one contract form and sold in one set of counties, and the network conditions it places on the member follow the plan held.

| Plan | Contract form | Referral needed for an in-network specialist visit | Primary care provider carried on the enrollment | Provider cost-share tiers in the network | Annual plan payment limit for emergency care outside the United States (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | HMO | yes | yes | 1 | 25000 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | HMO | yes | yes | 1 | 25000 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | HMO-POS | no | yes | 2 | 50000 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | PPO | no | no | 2 | 50000 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | PPO | no | no | 2 | 100000 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | PPO | no | no | 3 | 100000 |

### Counties in which each plan may be sold and held

| Plan | Service area counties |
| --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick, Sable Hollow |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick, Sable Hollow, Fenn |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick, Sable Hollow, Fenn, Quarry Bend |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick, Sable Hollow, Fenn, Quarry Bend, Teale |

A referral from the primary care provider is needed for an in-network specialist visit only on the two plans written as HMO contracts. A primary care provider is carried on the enrollment record on those two plans and on Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS); on the three PPO-form plans none is carried. Ridgecrest, Alder and Marwick are in the service area of every plan; Teale is in the service area of Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) alone.
